subject: [PATCH v2 4/8] nfsd: rename nfsd_mutex to nfsd_global_mutex

2026-09-22.patch_summary: This patch renames the 'nfsd_mutex' to 'nfsd_global_mutex' in various NFS daemon files, providing clarity on which mutex is being referenced at each call site. This change does not introduce any functional changes but rather improves code readability and maintainability. The rename affects several files within the NFS daemon's source code, including filecache.c, netns.h, nfsctl.c, nfsd.h, and nfssvc.c.
